requirement: Before any project-controlled public distribution or hosted service, perform role-specific legal/privacy/compliance review for the jurisdictions in which that concrete actor/service is offered. No country is a protocol-global gate.
Before broad external normative protocol contributions, finalize counsel-reviewed royalty-free essential-patent disclosure/license/non-assert language and mixed-license packaging guidance.
Before asserting official compatibility/trademark status at scale, publish a policy preventing impersonation while allowing truthful OM-compatible/implements-OM claims.
Each project-controlled app-store distribution defines the reporting/moderation/privacy/commerce processes required by that store/jurisdiction without making them universal protocol services.
Stand up TUF-style release metadata, physically separated founder-held 2-of-3 offline root custody during S0, delegated routine signing, provenance, reproducibility evidence and independent mirrors.
Validate opaque push/VAPID lifecycle and background behavior on the supported iOS/iPadOS/Android/desktop browser/native platform matrix.
Complete LinkPreviewProvider privacy design plus SSRF/rebinding/redirect/resource-exhaustion sandbox tests.
Publish the native/PWA LocalDiscoveryProvider capability matrix and local-network permission behavior without making one browser API mandatory.
Define how clients/providers obtain and display operator/ASN/cloud/DNS/region/implementation diversity evidence beyond self-declared metadata.
Before claiming interoperable EvidencePackage export, freeze selective-disclosure encoding and language that avoids overclaiming non-repudiation.

Before advertising public key/directory transparency, select/review the optional per-directory witness/transparency mechanism; relationship-scoped head gossip remains sufficient for v1 private continuity.

Before the first public release of any project-controlled distribution: published security contact (security.txt/SECURITY.md), signed advisory channel, embargo/coordination policy and voluntary implementer contact list (ADR-0104).

Before public-production resilience claims: a second reference Home implementation with no cloud-vendor dependency passes provider conformance and onboarding offers a vendor-neutral zero-signup path (ADR-0102, V-020).

Before any project-controlled public or provider-readable surface (Publication mirror, directory, Home list, catalog, public blob host, unfurl service) launches: role-scoped illegal-content intake/takedown/preservation/referral process for its jurisdictions; no client-side scanning of private E2EE (R-181).
